sources_note: All figures from Wayback Machine captures of CME's public CmeWS margins CSV; live cmegroup.com returned HTTP 403 (IP blocked as scraping). Captured advisory chadv26-266 (effective after close 2026-08-07) changes none of these products; advisories after 2026-08-07 are not captured, so later changes are unknown.
tos_flag: CME Terms of Use 8(vi) (Wayback 2026-09-27 capture) prohibits use of website data 'in connection with the use of such technologies, tools, or models [AI] to generate any information'. Lead/user decision.
